benchmark_target: Versioned reproducible public-data AC benchmark for the Portuguese >=60 kV network

items.criterion: No mapped E-REDES load facility lacks its annual capacity reference
Every mapped generator satisfies 0 <= P <= available nameplate
Each material public generation category is reconciled to an official aggregate and discrepancies remain explicit
Any repeated overload corridor is source-backed or labeled as parameter-sensitive
Aggregate storage accounting is exact and spatial allocation is labeled or tested by sensitivity
RNT/RND/transformer scopes are separated and the monthly-vs-snapshot mismatch is reported
REE or ENTSO-E aggregate exchange is available independently of REN
Use synchronous E-REDES load or label the scenario as a prior-year seasonal proxy
Named delivery points are mapped where public evidence exists; aggregate future clients remain residual
No claim of real-time breaker, disconnector, or busbar state
No claim that solved voltages or angles reproduce SCADA/PMU state estimates
Protection, reserve, AGC, and remedial-action settings are excluded
Static ratings are used; weather is context rather than conductor-level DLR
Transformer taps and reactive-device switching are evidence-ranked assumptions
Individual corridor flows are model outputs, not observed telemetry
